units.name: Centre for Logistics, Procurement and Supply Chain Management
units.evidence: Official center name; agile/lean and manufacturing supply chains, simulation, procurement and decision support. Faculty-group label refers to the same field and overlapping roster; represented once under the center full name.

units.name: Sustainable Manufacturing Systems Centre (SMSC)
units.evidence: Explicit manufacturing systems modelling/simulation, operations excellence, manufacturing management and eco-factory design; official SMSC acronym.

units.name: Technology Management Group
units.evidence: Group within Centre for Systems and Technology Management; enterprise operational performance, procurement and logistics research/education.

units.name: Applied Informatics, Modelling and Simulation
units.evidence: Explicit group within Centre for Defence and Security Management and Informatics; operational and decision analysis, mathematical analysis and simulation.

units.name: Centre for Digital Engineering and Manufacturing (CDEM)
units.evidence: Official CDEM acronym; factory/process simulation, real-time factory simulation for optimum throughput and optimized product-service systems.

units.name: Centre for Life-cycle Engineering and Management (CLEM)
units.evidence: Official CLEM acronym; optimized maintenance planning/scheduling, support and logistics across asset life cycles.

units.name: Centre for Air Transport Management
units.evidence: Named center integrates operations, planning and management of airlines and airports, with research and teaching remit.

decisions.reason: Imported faculty-group label consolidated under the full officially named Centre for Logistics, Procurement and Supply Chain Management; not relabeled as a department.
